privacy: HarmonyQuotes 行情助手隐私声明：本应用所有数据（自选列表、持仓记录、净值历史、提醒设置、主题偏好）均仅存储在设备本地数据库与本地偏好文件中。本应用不采集任何个人信息，不上传任何数据至服务器，不与第三方共享任何数据。行情数据为本地模拟引擎生成（几何布朗运动随机游走），非真实市场数据。清除数据功能将彻底删除全部本地数据。

HarmonyQuotes Privacy Statement: All data in this app (watchlist, positions, nav history, alert settings, theme preferences) is stored only in the on-device database and local preference files. This app collects no personal information, uploads no data to any server, and shares nothing with third parties. Quotation data is generated by a local simulation engine (geometric Brownian motion), not real market data. The clear-data feature permanently deletes all local data.
